## Overnight Idea

**Periodically consolidating the memory store into concise summaries, then applying MemGPT’s virtual context paging, should dramatically reduce cross‑fact interference and preserve QA accuracy beyond the 40‑item drop observed (d2609f66).**  
*Leverage this insight to design the consolidation schedule for the May ablation runs.*
